description: This file defines the SecurityAdvisory class, a value object representing security advisories from Drupal.org, including validation, creation, and accessor methods.

classes.name: SecurityAdvisory
classes.description: A value object representing a security advisory, with properties like title, project, type, PSA status, insecure versions, and URL, along with methods for creation, validation, and data access.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a SecurityAdvisory instance from an array of data, validating the data beforehand.

methods.name: validateAdvisoryData
methods.description: Validates the advisory data array against constraints, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the advisory.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Returns the project name associated with the advisory.

methods.name: isCoreAdvisory
methods.description: Checks if the advisory is for core.

methods.name: isPsa
methods.description: Checks if the advisory is a public service announcement.

methods.name: getInsecureVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of insecure versions.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to the advisory.
